PH.localized: Kumusta! Demo lang ito para sa life insurance renewal.
PH.literal_translation: Magandang araw. Ito ay isang demonstrasyon para sa pag-renew ng seguro sa buhay.
PH.reason: The Taglish option uses familiar sector wording and a conversational opening while naming the demo clearly.

PH.localized: Gusto mo bang pag-usapan ang premium, beneficiary, rider, o coverage? Ang actual terms ay nasa policy mo.
PH.literal_translation: Nais mo bang talakayin ang premium, benepisyaryo, karagdagang saklaw, o proteksiyon?
PH.reason: Keeps common English finance terms customers use and adds a clear reminder that the actual contract controls.

PH.localized: Wala sa approved demo source ang info na iyan. Gusto mo bang ipa-check sa representative?
PH.literal_translation: Ang impormasyong iyan ay wala sa pinahintulutang sanggunian.
PH.reason: Uses natural Taglish and offers a practical next step in the same register.

ID.localized: Silakan cek jadwal cicilan dan tanggal jatuh tempo di kanal resmi.
ID.literal_translation: Mohon periksa jadwal angsuran dan tanggal jatuh tempo pada saluran resmi.
ID.reason: Uses everyday cicilan while retaining the precise due-date term jatuh tempo.

ID.localized: Kalau lagi sulit bayar, saya bisa minta petugas cek pilihan resmi buat Anda.
ID.literal_translation: Jika Anda mengalami kesulitan melakukan pembayaran, saya dapat meminta petugas memeriksa pilihan resmi.
ID.reason: Acknowledges the difficulty plainly without promising a fee waiver or loan change.

ID.localized: Petugas bisa bantu cek tenor, DP, atau angsuran yang sesuai perjanjian Anda.
ID.literal_translation: Petugas dapat membantu memeriksa jangka waktu, uang muka, atau cicilan sesuai perjanjian Anda.
ID.reason: Keeps familiar finance loanwords DP and tenor while directing factual confirmation to an agent.
